name: Tea caddy
dimensions: Height 13.7 cm; Width 21.4 cm; Depth 12.5 cm
summary: The interior of this lacquered box is divided into two compartments. Each contains a pewter tea caddy with two sets of lids. The lid of the box is inscribed with the owner's monogram WJCCB. This piece is a typical export item, and a reminder that tea was originally an expensive luxury.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
